title: Backport request: CVE-2026-33414 (hyperV powershell path escape) on v5.5
body:
The fix for CVE-2026-33414 ([commit `571c842bd3`](https://github.com/containers/podman/commit/571c842bd3), PR [#24289](https://github.com/containers/podman/pull/24289)) doesn't appear on `v5.5`.

### What I checked

- `compare v5.5...571c842bd3` -> `status=diverged, ahead=1989, behind=106`
- `pkg/machine/hyperv/stubber.go` on `v5.5` is at blob `a2116a69...` (same as v5.6, i.e. still using the pre-fix `Resize-VHD "%s"` path interpolation in `resizeDisk`)
- Title-scan of recent commits on `v5.5` finds nothing matching "powershell path escape" or `CVE-2026-33414`

### Why it matters

The pre-fix code passes a user-controlled image path straight into a PowerShell command string, where PowerShell can reinterpret special characters. The patch routes the path through `$ENV:IMAGE_PATH` to avoid that.

### Action

Cherry-pick `571c842bd3` onto `v5.5` if the branch is still maintained. Companion issues:

- `v5.7`: [#28618](https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/28618)
- `v5.6`: [#28619](https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/28619)

The patch itself is `+2/-1` in a single function, no API change.

*External report from a sweep for un-backported security fixes. Please close if `v5.5` is end-of-life.*
